title: search_logged_models metric ordering: keep one latest metric row per logged model so paging does not repeat models
answers: Why does paging through logged models sorted by a metric return the same model on several pages?
Why are some logged models missing or duplicated when sorting logged models by a metric like accuracy with a page size?
Where is the metric-based sort for logged models built in the tracking store?
body:
Path: mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py:_apply_order_by_search_logged_models handles order_by on search_logged_models (logged model listing, the model-search API and UI sort by metrics.<name>). It builds a per-model subquery over SqlLoggedModelMetric rows for that metric name and outer-joins it onto the model query before pagination.
Rule: Reduce the metric subquery to exactly one row per model_id with row_number() (not rank()), partitioned by model_id and ordered by metric_timestamp_ms desc, metric_step desc, run_id asc, then filter row_num == 1. The run_id tie-breaker makes the choice deterministic when tied metric rows come from different datasets.
Symptom: When a metric had tied latest values across datasets for the same logged model, rank() returned several rows with rank 1 for that model. The outer join then produced duplicate model rows, so page 1 showed one model and later pages repeated or skipped models, and the page token did not stop at the right place.
Constraints: Applies to ordering by a metric in logged-model search. Ordering by plain model fields (e.g. creation_timestamp_ms, model_id) does not use this subquery. Other metric-based queries elsewhere in the store were not changed by this PR.
applies: Logged model search ordering by metric in the SQLAlchemy tracking store; affects any change to that ordering subquery or its window function.
says: Paging through models sorted by a metric shows duplicate entries across different pages.
Some models are skipped or repeated when navigating paginated model search results.
Sorting the model table by accuracy causes the same model to appear twice.
Ensure paginated model listings display each model once when sorting by evaluation metrics.
Model search pagination breaks and repeats items when metric values tie across datasets.
search: In mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py:_apply_order_by_search_logged_models, metric ordering for search_logged_models must deduplicate SqlLoggedModelMetric subqueries to one row per model_id using row_number() instead of rank(). The window function partitions by model_id and orders by metric_timestamp_ms desc, metric_step desc, and run_id asc as a deterministic tie-breaker across datasets before filtering for row_num == 1. This prevents duplicate model rows from appearing after outer-joins, eliminating repeated or skipped models during search pagination. Applies strictly to metric-based ordering subqueries in SQLAlchemy store logged model searches, without affecting searches sorted by standard model fields.
